assessment_objectives.objective: the knowledge, documentation, configurations, credentials, procedures and operational responsibilities that must be transferred upon cessation of third-party services are identified for each applicable third-party relationship.

knowledge, documentation and procedures necessary to operate and maintain the affected services are transferred to authorized personnel, a replacement third-party or internally-managed service before the cessation of third-party services.

configurations and credentials necessary to operate and maintain the affected services are transferred through protected means to authorized recipients, and transferred credentials are changed upon receipt.
operational responsibilities for the affected services are formally handed over to named personnel or the replacement service provider before the cessation of third-party services.
completion of the knowledge and operational transfer is confirmed and recorded before the third-party services cease.
